fix.rationale:
RETIME, 0 added cycles. The violating path leaves the cycle_counter flop (uart_rx.v:170), runs through the 14-bit CYCLES_PER_BIT / CYCLES_PER_BIT/2 equality tree (NOR4/NAND4/OAI22/NOR2/AOI211, 0.31 ns) and the FSM_STOP qualification that forms uart_rx_valid (the two AND3s + NAND3, 0.31 ns, the 0.130 ns AND3 being the high-fanout valid/write-enable net), then leaves the module into the gray-code XOR chain and full-compare of wptr_full.v (cells 9-12, 0.24 ns). 0.62 of the 0.94 ns is therefore in this file, and uart_rx_valid was a purely combinational output sitting mid-path with no register on it.

Cut/move: uart_rx_valid is retimed backwards across the existing cycle_counter and fsm_state registers. Instead of evaluating (fsm_state==FSM_STOP)&&next_bit on the current register values, the identical function is evaluated on their NEXT values and captured in uart_rx_valid_q, so the port waveform is bit-identical cycle for cycle and the input-to-output register count is unchanged (no added latency). cycle_counter and fsm_state are retained because they have other fan-out - standard retiming with register sharing. Derivation is exact, not reachability-based: fsm_state'==FSM_STOP <=> (RECV&&payload_done)||(STOP&&!next_bit), both of which imply the counter is in an incrementing state, so cycle_counter' = next_bit ? 0 : cycle_counter+1; when next_bit holds, cycle_counter'==0 matches neither constant (covered by the explicit !next_bit factor), otherwise cycle_counter+1==K <=> cycle_counter==K-1 with no wrap since K-1 fits in COUNT_REG_LEN bits. Synchronous active-low reset clears the new flop to 0, matching the golden value under reset (fsm_state'=IDLE). New arrival at the flop D is ~0.45 ns of logic (the same 5-level compare tree, now in parallel with next_bit, plus one AND); downstream the path now launches from a flop into only the wptr_full XOR/compare chain (~0.63 ns) - both comfortably inside the ~0.92 ns requirement.

Reconvergence: nothing needed re-balancing. uart_rx_break is the only internal consumer of uart_rx_valid and is left as valid && ~|recieved_data - since uart_rx_valid_q carries the same value in the same cycle and recieved_data is untouched, break is unchanged. uart_rx_data, the FSM, both counters and the sampler are byte-for-byte unmodified, so all three outputs keep their original latency.

Rejected PIPELINE: it would cost a cycle and force uart_rx_data and uart_rx_break to be delayed to match the golden-delayed wrapper, for only -0.02 ns of slack. Rejected RESTRUCTURE: the equality tree is already a balanced 5-level network and the only Boolean simplification available, A&&(B||(A&&C)) == A&&(B||C), is already applied in the source and folded by synthesis, so it buys no levels; rebuilding it from wider gates would be slower per the cell-cost table. Rejected NO_FIX: the dominant cone is in this file and a legal register boundary exists.
